
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/minjh/p/20122089" title="发布于 2026-05-22 16:42">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">React 可拖拽列宽 + 点击行选中 ProTable 封装笔记</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<p>平时做后台管理系统，Ant Design Pro 的 ProTable 用得特别多，但原生组件缺少<strong>列宽拖拽调整</strong>和<strong>点击行选中</strong>这两个高频功能，每次都要重复写逻辑。</p>
<p>所以我把这两个功能封装成了通用组件，后续项目直接复用，这里整理成笔记方便自己查阅。</p>
<h2 id="一整体思路">一、整体思路</h2>
<p>把功能拆成两部分解耦：</p>
<ol>
<li><strong>列宽拖拽核心逻辑</strong>：独立封装可调整表头组件，无业务侵入</li>
<li><strong>ProTable 业务封装</strong>：集成列宽拖拽 + 点击行选中 + 选中状态受控/非受控 + 暴露清空选中方法</li>
</ol>
<p>两个文件配合使用，开箱即用，支持 TypeScript，兼容 ProTable 所有原生属性。</p>
<hr>
<h2 id="二列宽拖拽表头封装resizabletitletsx">二、列宽拖拽表头封装（ResizableTitle.tsx）</h2>
<p>这是列宽拖拽的核心，基于原生 th 实现鼠标按下、移动、抬起的完整拖拽逻辑，最小宽度限制 80px，右侧有拖拽触发区，体验接近 Excel。</p>
<pre><code class="language-tsx">import React, { useState, useCallback } from 'react';

// 表格列配置类型
export interface TableColumnType {
  width?: number;
  title?: React.ReactNode;
  dataIndex?: string;
  key?: string;
  [key: string]: any;
}

// 表头组件
interface ResizableTitleProps {
  width?: number;
  onResize?: (width: number) =&gt; void;
  [key: string]: any;
}

const ResizableTitle: React.FC&lt;ResizableTitleProps&gt; = (props) =&gt; {
  const { width, onResize, ...restProps } = props;
  const [isResizing, setIsResizing] = useState(false);

  // 鼠标按下开始拖拽
  const handleMouseDown = useCallback((e: React.MouseEvent) =&gt; {
    const thRect = e.currentTarget.getBoundingClientRect();
    // 只在右侧 10px 区域触发拖拽
    const isOnEdge = e.clientX &gt; thRect.right - 10;
    if (!isOnEdge) return;

    e.preventDefault();
    setIsResizing(true);

    const startX = e.clientX;
    const startWidth = thRect.width;

    // 拖拽中实时更新宽度
    const handleMouseMove = (moveEvent: MouseEvent) =&gt; {
      const diff = moveEvent.clientX - startX;
      const newWidth = Math.max(80, startWidth + diff);
      onResize?.(newWidth);
    };

    // 松开鼠标结束拖拽
    const handleMouseUp = () =&gt; {
      setIsResizing(false);
      document.removeEventListener('mousemove', handleMouseMove);
      document.removeEventListener('mouseup', handleMouseUp);
    };

    document.addEventListener('mousemove', handleMouseMove);
    document.addEventListener('mouseup', handleMouseUp);
  }, [onResize]);

  return (
    &lt;th
      {...restProps}
      onMouseDown={handleMouseDown}
      style={{
        width,
        position: 'relative',
        paddingRight: '10px',
        cursor: isResizing ? 'col-resize' : undefined,
        userSelect: 'none',
      }}
    &gt;
      {/* 拖拽触发区域 */}
      &lt;span
        style={{
          position: 'absolute',
          right: 0,
          top: 0,
          bottom: 0,
          width: '10px',
          cursor: 'col-resize',
          backgroundColor: 'transparent',
        }}
        onMouseEnter={(e) =&gt; {
          e.currentTarget.style.backgroundColor = 'rgba(22, 119, 255, 0.1)';
        }}
        onMouseLeave={(e) =&gt; {
          if (!isResizing) {
            e.currentTarget.style.backgroundColor = 'transparent';
          }
        }}
      /&gt;
      {props.children}
    &lt;/th&gt;
  );
};

// 注入到 ProTable 表头
export const components = {
  header: {
    cell: ResizableTitle,
  },
};

// 处理列配置，绑定拖拽回调
export const getMergeColumns = (
  columns: TableColumnType[],
  setColumns: React.Dispatch&lt;React.SetStateAction&lt;TableColumnType[]&gt;&gt;
) =&gt; {
  return columns.map((col, index) =&gt; ({
    ...col,
    onHeaderCell: (column: TableColumnType) =&gt; ({
      width: column.width,
      onResize: (newWidth: number) =&gt; {
        setColumns((prev: TableColumnType[]) =&gt; {
          const next = [...prev];
          next[index] = {
            ...next[index],
            width: newWidth,
          };
          return next;
        });
      },
    }),
  }));
};

export default ResizableTitle;
</code></pre>
<h3 id="核心要点">核心要点</h3>
<ul>
<li>拖拽只触发在表头右侧 10px 区域，不影响正常点击</li>
<li>最小宽度 80px，防止列被缩没</li>
<li>鼠标悬浮拖拽区有淡蓝色提示，体验更好</li>
<li>对外暴露 <code>components</code> 和 <code>getMergeColumns</code> 供 ProTable 集成</li>
</ul>
<hr>
<h2 id="三protable-业务封装myprotabletsx">三、ProTable 业务封装（MyProTable.tsx）</h2>
<p>在 ProTable 基础上集成：</p>
<ul>
<li>列宽拖拽</li>
<li>点击行选中（支持单选/多选）</li>
<li>选中状态支持外部受控 / 内部非受控</li>
<li>暴露 <code>clearSelected</code> 方法清空选中</li>
<li>搜索栏按钮顺序调整（查询在前，重置在后）</li>
<li>完全兼容 ProTable 原有属性</li>
</ul>
<pre><code class="language-tsx">import { ProTable, type ProTableProps } from '@ant-design/pro-components';
import React, { forwardRef, useImperativeHandle, useState } from 'react';
import { components, getMergeColumns } from '../ResizableTitle';

// 暴露给父组件的方法
export interface MyProTableRef {
  clearSelected: () =&gt; void;
}

// 扩展 ProTable 属性
export type MyProTableProps&lt;
  T extends Record&lt;string, any&gt;,
  U extends Record&lt;string, any&gt; = Record&lt;string, any&gt;,
  ValueType = 'text'
&gt; = ProTableProps&lt;T, U, ValueType&gt; &amp; {
  enableRowSelect?: boolean; // 是否开启点击选中
  selectedRowKeys?: React.Key[]; // 外部受控选中key
  onSelectedChange?: (keys: React.Key[], rows: T[]) =&gt; void; // 选中变化回调
  multiple?: boolean; // 是否多选
};

const MyProTableInner = &lt;
  T extends Record&lt;string, any&gt;,
  U extends Record&lt;string, any&gt; = Record&lt;string, any&gt;,
  ValueType = 'text'
&gt;(
  props: MyProTableProps&lt;T, U, ValueType&gt;,
  ref: React.ForwardedRef&lt;MyProTableRef&gt;
) =&gt; {
  const {
    enableRowSelect = true,
    selectedRowKeys,
    onSelectedChange,
    multiple = false,
    rowKey = 'id' as keyof T,
    columns = [],
    ...restProps
  } = props;

  // 内部选中状态（非受控模式）
  const [innerKeys, setInnerKeys] = useState&lt;React.Key[]&gt;([]);
  const finalKeys = selectedRowKeys ?? innerKeys;

  // 列宽拖拽状态
  const [renderColumns, setRenderColumns] = useState&lt;any[]&gt;(columns);
  const resizeColumns = getMergeColumns(renderColumns, setRenderColumns as any);

  // 选中变化统一处理
  const handleChange = (keys: React.Key[], rows: T[]) =&gt; {
    if (selectedRowKeys === undefined) setInnerKeys(keys);
    onSelectedChange?.(keys, rows);
  };

  // 获取行唯一 key
  const getRowKey = (record: T): React.Key =&gt; {
    if (typeof rowKey === 'function') return rowKey(record);
    return record[rowKey] as React.Key;
  };

  // 点击行触发选中
  const handleClick = (record: T) =&gt; {
    if (!enableRowSelect) return;
    const key = getRowKey(record);

    let newKeys: React.Key[];
    if (multiple) {
      // 多选：切换当前行选中状态
      newKeys = finalKeys.includes(key)
        ? finalKeys.filter((k) =&gt; k !== key)
        : [...finalKeys, key];
    } else {
      // 单选：只保留当前行或清空
      newKeys = finalKeys.includes(key) ? [] : [key];
    }

    // 匹配选中行数据
    const selectedRows = newKeys
      .map((k) =&gt; restProps.dataSource?.find((item) =&gt; getRowKey(item) === k))
      .filter((item): item is T =&gt; !!item);

    handleChange(newKeys, selectedRows);
  };

  // 暴露方法给父组件
  useImperativeHandle(ref, () =&gt; ({
    clearSelected: () =&gt; handleChange([], []),
  }));

  return (
    &lt;ProTable&lt;T, U, ValueType&gt;
      {...restProps}
      rowKey={rowKey}
      columns={resizeColumns as any}
      components={components} // 注入可拖拽表头
      onRow={(record) =&gt; ({
        ...restProps.onRow?.(record),
        onClick: () =&gt; handleClick(record), // 绑定点击行事件
      })}
      rowClassName={(record, index, indent) =&gt; {
        const key = getRowKey(record);
        const isSelected = finalKeys.includes(key);
        let customClass = '';

        // 兼容外部传入的 className
        if (typeof restProps.rowClassName === 'function') {
          customClass = restProps.rowClassName(record, index, indent);
        } else if (typeof restProps.rowClassName === 'string') {
          customClass = restProps.rowClassName;
        }

        return isSelected ? `table-row-selected ${customClass}` : customClass;
      }}
      // 搜索栏：查询按钮在前，重置按钮在后
      search={{
        ...restProps.search,
        optionRender: (_searchConfig, _formProps, dom) =&gt; {
          if (!dom || dom.length &lt; 2) return dom;
          const [resetBtn, submitBtn] = dom;
          return [submitBtn, resetBtn];
        },
      }}
    /&gt;
  );
};

// 转发 ref，支持泛型
const MyProTable = forwardRef(MyProTableInner) as &lt;
  T extends Record&lt;string, any&gt;,
  U extends Record&lt;string, any&gt; = Record&lt;string, any&gt;,
  ValueType = 'text'
&gt;(
  props: MyProTableProps&lt;T, U, ValueType&gt; &amp; { ref?: React.ForwardedRef&lt;MyProTableRef&gt; }
) =&gt; React.ReactElement;

export default MyProTable;
</code></pre>
<h3 id="样式补充全局加一行即可">样式补充（全局加一行即可）</h3>
<p>选中行高亮样式，在全局 <code>global.less</code> 中添加：</p>
<pre><code class="language-less">.table-row-selected {
  background-color: rgba(22, 119, 255, 0.1) !important;
}
</code></pre>
<hr>
<h2 id="四使用示例">四、使用示例</h2>
<p>封装完后使用非常简单，和普通 ProTable 用法几乎一致：</p>
<pre><code class="language-tsx">import React, { useRef } from 'react';
import MyProTable, { MyProTableRef } from './MyProTable';

const DemoPage = () =&gt; {
  const tableRef = useRef&lt;MyProTableRef&gt;(null);

  const columns = [
    { title: 'ID', dataIndex: 'id', width: 100 },
    { title: '姓名', dataIndex: 'name', width: 150 },
    { title: '年龄', dataIndex: 'age', width: 120 },
    { title: '地址', dataIndex: 'address' },
  ];

  // 选中回调
  const handleSelect = (keys, rows) =&gt; {
    console.log('选中keys：', keys);
    console.log('选中数据：', rows);
  };

  return (
    &lt;div&gt;
      &lt;button onClick={() =&gt; tableRef.current?.clearSelected()}&gt;
        清空选中
      &lt;/button&gt;

      &lt;MyProTable
        ref={tableRef}
        columns={columns}
        rowKey="id"
        multiple={true} // 开启多选
        onSelectedChange={handleSelect}
        request={async () =&gt; {
          // 模拟接口
          return {
            data: [
              { id: 1, name: '张三', age: 20, address: '北京' },
              { id: 2, name: '李四', age: 25, address: '上海' },
            ],
            total: 2,
          };
        }}
      /&gt;
    &lt;/div&gt;
  );
};

export default DemoPage;
</code></pre>
<hr>
<h2 id="五使用心得">五、使用心得</h2>
<ol>
<li>列宽拖拽和业务完全解耦，后续想用到普通 Table 也能快速抽离</li>
<li>点击行选中支持单选/多选，满足大部分列表场景</li>
<li>选中状态支持受控/非受控，适配表单联动或独立使用</li>
<li>完全兼容 ProTable 原生属性，老项目改造成本极低</li>
<li>封装后项目里只需要引入 <code>MyProTable</code>，不用再写重复逻辑</li>
</ol>
<p>这个封装基本覆盖了后台系统表格 90% 的常用场景，后续直接复制这两个文件就能用。</p>
